problems.name: Karl is freezing
problems.description: It's cold on the steppe. Karl's goosebumps have goosebumps.

problems.name: Bare hands
problems.description: Karl has two hands and zero tools. Nature is laughing at him.

problems.name: Karl is hungry
problems.description: Karl's stomach growls so loudly the boar keeps its distance.

problems.name: Karl is bored
problems.description: Karl has survived the day. The day, it turns out, is very long.

problems.name: Karl is alone
problems.description: Karl has invented several things and has nobody to show them to.

problems.name: Karl wonders why
problems.description: Warm, fed, accompanied. And still awake at night, thinking.
